blind.description: A dungeon or crypt prop consisting of a weathered rectangular stone wall slab with an integrated step seat, upon which sits a full humanoid skeleton. The skeleton's wrists are bound in iron manacles chained to iron wall rings above, with its head hanging forward and feet resting on the lower step. The geometry is clean, solid, and stylized, featuring dark grey-brown textured stone, realistic aged bone textures, and dark rusted iron chains.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a thick dark rectangular stone top edge behind the top of a skull, flanked by chain cuffs, with the skeleton's bent knees and large skeletal feet projecting forward onto the rectangular base ledge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (around 80% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.

notes: Footprint is slightly deeper than catalog estimate due to the stepped seat and forward-projecting feet, but proportions remain tall and readable.
